title: core: ResolveLocalizationInput.tenantId takes an organization id but does not say so — cloud passed the environment id for months and every hosted environment resolved UTC; rename or brand it
body:
Filing gate ③: maintainer direct dispatch, 2026-10-24, in the cloud ops seat's chat: 「可以：在 objectstack 立这两张改进卡（时区接口参数名、跨仓公开类型改动同步落地），挂 pm:queue。」 ⛔ Not a claim.

**Reader who acts:** the `domain:engine` seat. `resolveLocalizationContext` and `ResolveLocalizationInput` live in `@objectstack/core`.

## What happened

`ResolveLocalizationInput.tenantId` (`packages/core/src/security/resolve-authz-context.ts:2181`, on `main` `45f996231e`) means the **organization** id: the settings service stores and reads the tenant rung by organization. The name does not say so.

objectstack-ai/cloud passed the **environment** id there from its three AI entry points: `agent-routes` (`chatContext.environmentId`), `ai-routes` `/chat` and `tool-routes`. The consequences:
- every hosted environment resolved its organization's timezone as `UTC`;
- the AI's "today" and `{today}` filter boundaries were cut in UTC for every non-UTC organization;
- the defect lasted for months after cloud#1496 / #1498 claimed to fix it.

Unit tests stayed green because they only exercised the "settings service unavailable → read `sys_setting` directly" fallback, which did not filter by organization until #25301 narrowed it. cloud fixed its callers in cloud#3150 (merged `1b26a28b`) and pinned the fix with a real hosted-kernel e2e.

A rig measurement on a real hosted kernel, with the organization timezone `Asia/Shanghai`:

| `tenantId` passed | Timezone resolved |
|:--|:--|
| the environment id | `UTC` |
| the organization id | `Asia/Shanghai` |
| absent | `Asia/Shanghai` |

## Wanted

Make the parameter say what it takes, so this class of mistake cannot type-check. The seat picks the shape:
- **(a) Rename** `tenantId` → `organizationId` on `ResolveLocalizationInput`. It is a published `@objectstack/core` export, so the rename needs this repo's deprecation and ADR-0087 treatment. There are 4 in-repo callers: `request-execution-context.ts:274`, `mcp/src/plugin.ts:669`, `plugin-audit/src/audit-plugin.ts:387`, `plugin-hono-server/src/current-user-endpoints.ts:742`.
- **(b) Keep the key and brand the type:** an `OrganizationId` brand that an environment id cannot satisfy without a cast.
- **(c) Both.**

The settings service's own `{ tenantId, userId }` scope carries the same naming. Whether it moves with this change is the seat's call; say so on the card.

## Acceptance

- The input's name or type states it takes an organization id.
- Passing an environment-shaped value is caught at compile time (b) or is impossible to spell (a).
- In-repo callers are migrated.
- A changeset declares `Clause-②` / `Metadata-protocol` per this repo's rules.

## Dedupe

Searched with `gh api search/issues`, closed included:

| Query | Hits |
|:--|:--|
| `repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack resolveLocalizationContext tenantId` | 29 |
| `repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack localization tenantId organizationId rename` | 7 |

The nearest hits are #25301 and #25226, both merged: they narrowed the fallback and the settings rungs to the caller's organization (ADR-0131 D8) but kept the name. #22318 and #24235 are plugin-audit locale seams. None renames or brands the parameter. **New.**
